# Deep Dive Podcast with Raissa

> Long-form interview podcast hosted by Raissa. Conversations with founders, planners, clergy, civic voices, immigrants, and creatives. Published on YouTube as @DeepDives237. Website distribution only. No Spotify or Apple Podcasts.

The show prioritizes depth over reach. Episodes run long. Guests are chosen for what they have actually lived and built, not for the size of their audience. Topics include entrepreneurship, career, finance, relationships, faith, creativity, and immigrant journeys.

## Pages

- [Home](https://deepdives237.com/): Featured episode, recent conversations, host introduction, community signup.
- [Episodes](https://deepdives237.com/episodes): The full archive of long-form interviews.
- [About](https://deepdives237.com/about): Why Raissa started Deep Dives, the topics it covers, and the editorial point of view.
- [Guests](https://deepdives237.com/guests): The kinds of voices featured. Pitch yourself to be on the show.
- [Contact](https://deepdives237.com/contact): Guest pitches, press inquiries, partnerships.

## Watch

- [YouTube channel @DeepDives237](https://www.youtube.com/@DeepDives237): primary distribution. Every episode lives here.
